'''Kate''' (Japanese: '''ローズ''' ''Rose'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HS03|We're No Angels!]]''.

She is a fan of [[Team Righteous]] and has always liked watching them "on the news films," and is a little ditzy. She was very glad "[[Team Rocket trio|they]]" had come to help them against the yearly threat, a flock of {{p|Taillow}}. She seemed to have an immense crush on [[James]], constantly worrying of him and blushing when trying to convince him to stay. After saving the village, James wonders if he, [[Jessie]], and {{MTR}} should stay and help them in case of trouble, but they eventually got blasted off and returned to trying to steal {{AP|Pikachu}}.
